expectations.text: Cuts the starting channel list to what two part-time staff can fill
expectations.evidence: The draft's 12 SDK channels become one `#help` forum with 12 SDK tags. The stated reason is "12 empty rooms on day 1, with 2 part-time people to watch them." `#jobs` and `#memes` are deferred, which leaves a lean starting set of 7 public and 2 private channels. Each deferred channel gets an explicit trigger for being added later: per-SDK channels at 5+ threads a week for 3 weeks, `#jobs` at about 200 active members, and `#memes` when `#off-topic` is mostly memes. The fold-back rule shrinks the surface again if activity signals miss.
